title: c-PCR-003 Concrete and concrete elements (EN 16757:2022)
program_operator: EPD International AB (The International EPD System)

document.status_note: PDF p5 confirms version 1.0.0, published 2025-04-08, valid until 2030-04-07; revised when EN 16757 is revised by CEN/TC 229. environdec.com lists it as 'Registered' with registration number 2019:14-c-PCR-003.

depends_on_unavailable: EN 16757:2022 (entire normative content: declared/functional unit, modules, technical data, scenarios, RSL, cut-off/allocation specifics)
EN 16757:2022 CO2 uptake by carbonation method (c-PCR gives no clause reference)

rules.title: Product sub-category recorded
rules.requirement: The product type must be recorded so scope eligibility (concrete or concrete element, not autoclaved aerated concrete) can be checked.

rules.title: Autoclaved aerated concrete excluded
rules.requirement: The c-PCR covers concrete and concrete elements for building and civil engineering but excludes autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC); AAC products cannot use this c-PCR.

rules.title: UN CPC group 375
rules.requirement: The product category corresponds to UN CPC group 375 'Articles of concrete, cement and plaster' (when used in construction).

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-003 by registration number
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include its registration number (c-PCR-003).

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-003 by name
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include the c-PCR name.

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-003 version
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include its version number (1.0.0 for this ruleset).

rules.title: Used together with PCR 2019:14
rules.requirement: The c-PCR cannot be used on its own; it shall be applied together with PCR 2019:14 Construction products, so the EPD must also reference PCR 2019:14 (any valid version).

rules.title: Used together with EN 15804
rules.requirement: The c-PCR shall be applied together with EN 15804; the EPD must state conformance with EN 15804.

rules.title: EPD states conformance with EN 16757:2022
rules.requirement: Standards conformance for this c-PCR is EN 16757:2022; modules, LCA rules and EPD content follow PCR 2019:14 and EN 16757:2022, so the EPD should name EN 16757 as applied.

rules.title: c-PCR-003 v1.0.0 is valid at date of issue
rules.requirement: Version 1.0.0 was published 2025-04-08 and is valid until 2030-04-07; an EPD citing it should be issued within that window.

rules.title: Current edition EN 16757:2022 applied
rules.requirement: The c-PCR was updated for EN 16757:2022 and standard references mean the edition listed in section 7, so the superseded 2017 edition should not be cited as the basis.

manual_checks.title: Product is within scope of EN 16757:2022
manual_checks.reason: Scope is 'concrete and concrete elements for building and civil engineering as defined in EN 16757:2022' (excluding AAC). The definitions are in the unavailable standard; a reviewer must confirm the product fits.

manual_checks.title: Type of EPD and information modules per EN 16757:2022
manual_checks.reason: The c-PCR only says 'as in PCR 2019:14 and EN 16757:2022'. Any module restrictions, mandatory modules or allowed EPD types beyond the parent PCR are defined in EN 16757:2022, which is not available; a reviewer must check them.

manual_checks.title: LCA methodology per EN 16757:2022
manual_checks.reason: Declared/functional unit, system boundary, cut-off, allocation, default scenarios, RSL and any product-specific calculation rules are delegated to EN 16757:2022, including CO2 uptake by carbonation (use stage and end of life) and concrete-specific default scenarios. Not encoded because the standard is not available.

manual_checks.title: EPD content and format per EN 16757:2022
manual_checks.reason: Technical data to declare, additional information and any extra reporting/statements are delegated to EN 16757:2022; verify manually against the standard.

manual_checks.title: Deviations from 'should' recommendations justified
manual_checks.reason: Any deviation from a recommendation shall be justified in the EPD development process; whether a justification is adequate needs human judgement.

notes: Apart from scope and administrative data, every substantive section of this c-PCR (2.2.2 type of EPD/modules, 2.2.3 geography, 2.2.4 EPD validity, 4 LCA rules, 5 EPD content, 6 glossary) only says 'as in PCR 2019:14' and/or the EN standard. Rules from PCR 2019:14 are covered by parent ruleset epd-intl-pcr-2019-14-v2.0.1 and are not repeated here.
No defaults are given in the c-PCR itself; all default scenarios/values live in the unavailable EN standard or in the parent PCR, hence 'defaults' is empty.

Section 1.2 allows use with any valid version of PCR 2019:14 regardless of the version cited in the c-PCR, so pairing with parent ruleset epd-intl-pcr-2019-14-v2.0.1 is acceptable. No override of parent PCR rules is stated in this c-PCR.
The PCR was developed within CEN and adopted without extra open consultation or review (section 3); PCR moderator and committee are 'not applicable'.
REF.01-REF.04 and STD.01 search the full rendered EPD text (document.text); no doc_section is set to avoid depending on section naming.

VAL.01 compares ISO-8601 date strings lexicographically (expression string literals are an extension of the README syntax); it is derived from the c-PCR publication/validity dates and the GPI principle that a valid PCR must be used.
Obligation semantics (section 1.1): 'shall' = requirement, 'should' = recommendation whose deviation must be justified, 'may'/'can' = permitted option.
Declared/functional unit is not stated in the c-PCR (delegated to EN 16757:2022); no unit rule is encoded. Do not assume 1 m3 without the standard.
Carbonation (CO2 uptake) calculation is defined in EN 16757:2022 - not available; no formula check encoded.
Source error: section 7 cites 'PCR 2019:04 Construction products, version 2.0.0' - evidently a typo for PCR 2019:14.

Version history (section 8): 2019-12-20 original (from sub-PCR to PCR 2012:01), 2023-01-02 update for EN 16757:2022, 2024-04-30 validity alignment, 1.0.0 (2025-04-08) prolonged validity and switch to version numbers.

New field paths introduced: product.un_cpc_group (3-digit UN CPC group derived from product.classification_codes[]). Allowed values for product.sub_category used by SCOPE.02 ('autoclaved_aerated_concrete', 'aac') must be mapped by the adapter.
EN 16757:2022 itself is a CEN PCR built on EN 15804+A2; precedence rules between it and PCR 2019:14 are not stated in this c-PCR.
